product_overview: The Squad is a sports team, league, and tournament management platform for organizers, coaches, players, and parents. It supports authentication, dashboard access, league and tournament division management, and multi-form registration protocols with built-in division handling.
core_goals: Create an account and access the appropriate authenticated area
Log in and continue to the dashboard
Manage league divisions, fees, rules, standings, and schedules
Manage tournament divisions, roster assignments, itinerary filtering, and standings
Create and configure registration protocols with multiple forms and a locked Division field

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Users can sign up and log in to access the platform, then reach their authenticated workspace.
user_flows: Navigate to /signup -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Submit registration form -> See the dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Enter email -> Enter password -> Submit login form -> See the dashboard

features.name: League Division Management
features.description: League organizers can create divisions, configure division-specific settings, assign teams, and generate filtered schedules and standings.
user_flows: Navigate to /leagues -> Open Division Architect tab -> Add a division and enter its name -> Adjust division fee or rules override -> Assign teams to divisions -> Generate the schedule -> View division-filtered schedule and standings

Navigate to /leagues -> Open Division Architect tab -> Add multiple divisions -> Assign teams to different divisions -> Use division filter chips to narrow the schedule and standings -> Review the filtered results

features.name: Tournament Division Management
features.description: Tournament organizers can define divisions, assign teams to divisions, and filter tournament views by division.
user_flows: Navigate to /manage-tournaments -> Open Architecture tab -> Add divisions -> Switch to the Roster tab -> Select a division for each team -> Switch to the Itinerary tab -> Filter games by division -> View the division-specific itinerary and standings
Navigate to /manage-tournaments -> Open Architecture tab -> Add divisions -> Switch to the Roster tab -> Assign teams to divisions -> Review the updated division organization across tournament views

features.name: Protocol Architect Multi-Form with Divisions
features.description: Organizers can create and manage multiple registration forms, with a required Division field automatically included and locked in place.
user_flows: Navigate to /leagues/registration/[leagueId] -> View the existing form list -> Create a new form -> See the auto-injected Division field at the top of the field list -> Review the locked Division field in the form

Navigate to /manage-tournaments/registration/[teamId]/[eventId] -> View the existing form list -> Create a new form -> See the auto-injected Division field at the top of the field list -> Review the locked Division field in the form

routes.description: League management page with Division Architect, standings, and schedule generation
Tournament management page with Architecture, Division Architect, Roster, Itinerary, and Standings
League Protocol Architect with multi-form support and locked Division field
Tournament Protocol Architect with multi-form support and locked Division field

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Users can sign up, log in, select demo plans, and sign out.
user_interactions: Click Sign In button to submit

features.name: League Division Management
features.description: Elite league organizers can define divisions, set per-division entry fees/rules, assign teams, and generate schedules/standings filtered by division.
user_interactions: Click Add Division and enter name
Change per-division fee or rules override
Assign teams to divisions in Teams list
Filter schedule and standings using division filter chips

features.name: Tournament Division Management
features.description: Tournament organizers can define divisions in the Architecture tab, assign teams in the Roster tab, and view/filter itinerary and standings by division.
user_interactions: Open Architecture tab, view Division Architect card
Switch to Roster tab and select division for each team
Switch to Itinerary tab and filter games by division using context bar dropdown

features.name: Protocol Architect Multi-Form with Divisions
features.description: Organizers can manage multiple registration forms/protocols, create new forms, and use the auto-injected non-deletable Division dropdown field.
user_interactions: View list of existing forms and click Create Form button
See auto-injected Division field locked at the top of the form fields list
